WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as phase_avg,
    COUNT(t.bandusagepct) as phase_count
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(phase_avg) as mean_val
  FROM phase_stats
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ps.phase_avg),
  SUM(ps.phase_count),
  AVG(ps.phase_avg) - om.mean_val
FROM phase_stats ps
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ps.phase_avg > om.mean_val
